## What changed

Describe the observable change and why it is useful.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 tests/validate_repository.py`
- [ ] Rust tests pass
- [ ] Clippy passes with warnings denied
- [ ] Docker images build for amd64 and arm64
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behaviour changes

For scoring changes, include the reasoning and references in `docs/SCORING.md` or `docs/SCIENTIFIC_REFERENCES.md`.
